root_cause.text: The error path in `ipu6_pci_probe()` fails to set `isp->psys` to NULL when it holds an error pointer, causing a subsequent check that only tests for NULL to be true and leading to dereference of the error pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the condition from `if (isp->psys)` to `if (!IS_ERR_OR_NULL(isp->psys))` to prevent dereferencing an error pointer. The commit message explicitly states: "In a error path isp->psys is confirmed to be an error pointer not NULL so this condition is true and the error pointer is dereferenced."
